newsitem.title: USA: AutoImmune says colloral didnt beat placebo.
newsitem.headline: AutoImmune says colloral didnt beat placebo.

text.p: AutoImmune Inc said Monday although preliminary results from two Phase II trials of colloral for rheumatoid arthritis were positive, they showed no statistical difference versus the placebo.

The company said it believes, based on these data and previous trials, that colloral has therapeutic benefit. It may, however, require further development before entering Phase III trials. The company said it will conduct additional analysis of the colloral data before defining the next development steps for the product.
